{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string to float, removing commas
# Handle the QA orders (999999.99) and refunded orders (status == 'refunded')
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter out QA orders (revenue == 999999.99) and refunded orders (status == 'refunded')
df_clean = df[(df['revenue'] != 999999.99) & (df['status'] == 'completed')]

# Confirm the filter removed the expected rows
print(f'Original rows: {len(df)}')
print(f'Cleaned rows: {len(df_clean)}')
print(f'QA orders removed: {len(df) - len(df_clean)}')

# Check channel distribution
print('\nChannel distribution:')
print(df_clean['channel'].value_counts())

# Check customer_segment distribution
print('\nCustomer segment distribution:')
print(df_clean['customer_segment'].value_counts())

# Check converted rate by channel
converted_by_channel = df_clean.groupby('channel')['converted'].mean()
print('\nConversion rate by channel:')
print(converted_by_channel)

# Check conversion rate by segment
converted_by_segment = df_clean.groupby('customer_segment')['converted'].mean()
print('\nConversion rate by segment:')
print(converted_by_segment)

# Compare channel conversion rates after controlling for segment
# Use cross-tab to check balance
print('\nCross-tabulation of channel vs. customer_segment:')
print(pd.crosstab(df_clean['channel'], df_clean['customer_segment']))"}
